_comment.what: Live Google review standing for Jackson Roofing against real roofing contractors in Plano and the surrounding cities.

sources.discovery: gosom/google-maps-scraper v1.17.1 (MIT, no API key), the same binary ghl-cli/maps_prospector.py drives, run in fast-mode with geo coordinates for Plano. Used to build the candidate list of roofing contractors only.
sources.figures: Every rating and review count below was then read live on Google Maps on the pull date, because the scraper's fast-mode path returns a rating but no review count. Search pages read: google.com/maps/search/roofing+contractor+{Plano,Frisco,McKinney,Allen,Richardson}+TX. Jackson Roofing's own figures were read on its own Google Maps profile.
sources.clientSite: jacksonroofingco.com was NOT fetched. That domain returns 403 to our IP through Cloudflare, so nothing here comes from the client site.

_comment.honesty: Every number is a figure Google displayed on the pull date. The median, range and gap figures are plain arithmetic on those numbers. Nothing is estimated, modelled or projected: there is no 'reviews needed to rank', no lead figure and no revenue figure anywhere in this file.
